attributes.title: Find an execution
attributes.visState:
{"title": "Find an execution", "type": "markdown", "params": {"markdown": "### Search any execution identifier
Use the dashboard search bar: `correlationId: "value"` (or requestId, transactionId, traceId, workflowId).

Filter `eventType` by kafkaEvent, RestCall, Database, Workflow, Step, Criteria, Log or Dashboard. Select an appropriate time range.

Latency and success rates measure **instrumented operations**, including retries; they are not terminal workflow completion rates. Metric time series use bounded labels; execution duration and outcome can be filtered by identifiers in traces.", "fontSize": 12}}
